write_up: A recruiter sees an IT help desk internship, retail device setup, and an A+ certification. This is a common early-career resume: the work is named, but the school district bullets don't show how many tickets or laptops you handled, and nothing explains the time after May 2025. Those blanks can make a recruiter hesitate.

Let's start with the school district role and add the ticket and laptop details you can substantiate. The Active Directory line is a good model: it names both the task and the tool. Move Experience above Education, too, so your work comes first.
